FINAL_V2 / 1 - CAMERA PLOT FLY-THROUGH (4-path fusion)

360 pano -> 3D environment -> FOUR of your own camera paths -> WAN -> ONE fused SphereSfM COLMAP dataset.

Each 'Camera Plot Fly-Through + Geometry Overlay' node (4 of them, one per group) plots a path through anchors you type/drag in the editor, renders an equirect control video, and drives its own WAN branch. The four WAN videos feed the single SphereSfM node's pano_frames / pano_frames_2 / _3 / _4 inputs, which concatenates them into ONE reconstruction -- more coverage + parallax than a single path.

ANCHORS: one point per line. 'x,y,z' for look_forward / fixed_forward, or 'x,y,z, lookx,looky,lookz' (6 cols) for per_point_look. +Z forward, +X right, +Y up; origin = start camera. The geo node is WYSIWYG (absolute scene units), so the camera goes exactly where you place each anchor against the overlay cloud. Keep length = WAN length = 81.

UPSCALING (two paths, set on the SphereSfM node's 'mode'):
  - mode=colmap_now (default): builds the cube-face COLMAP dataset now. Upscale it with workflows/final_v2/2a_upscale_colmap_camera_sorted.json (camera-sorted so SeedVR2 gets coherent per-view sub-videos).
  - mode=panorama_only: saves the raw equirect panoramas and skips SfM. Upscale with 2b_upscale_panorama_then_sfm.json (upscales the coherent equirect video, THEN runs SphereSfM on the upscaled frames -- best quality).

TRAIN (pinhole COLMAP, NO --gut):
  LichtFeld-Studio.exe -d <model_dir> -o <out> --headless --train --strategy mcmc --max-cap 2000000 --sh-degree 2
A high quality panoramic video of the scene, photorealistic, very clear, smooth camera movement, ultra-detailed, high resolution. Panorama.
